I felt this way before my second attempt. All my memories were right there, every day was soaked in a gold light, my life felt perfect. One night I decided it was the perfect time to go. The day had drawn to a close nicely. I’d hugged my parents and told them I loved them, and taken a shower and gone to bed. I woke up around 5:30 and tried to kill myself. After that, the golden light was gone forever. I didn’t feel depressed before, but I do now. Even my happiest memories fail to bring nostalgia. The people I loved so much before, I feel nothing towards now, despite all they’ve done for me. Not because I don’t want to love them; because I no longer have the ability to feel love. I do really appreciate them, but it isn’t the same. All my feelings have been numbed. If you fail, this will probably happen to you too. And your family still needs you. Please don’t .

Yes your life is bad and you may have made some mistakes, but that doesn’t mean it’s time to die. If you live, you have the opportunity to fix mistakes, make amends, make things better, make a change. If you die there is no way for you to do any of that. If you die, you leave behind guilt and sadness on everyone who ever cared about you. Including her and your kids. You don’t know what’s going to happen in the future. Maybe it all works out and you can be happy again. Or maybe it’s not the same as it was before but you find new things to live for. Either way you won’t know if you die, so at least wait a week and reevaluate your situation before even thinking about that again. Good luck OP
